title: Mailboxes
subtitle: IMAP mailboxes this system polls for new mail. Each has its own encrypted credential or sign-in.
emptyDescription: Add a mailbox so the system has somewhere to ingest mail from.
mustBeArray: JSON must be an array of mailbox objects.
arrayEmpty: The array is empty — nothing to import.
itemNonEmptyString: Item {index}: "{field}" must be a non-empty string.
itemTlsBoolean: Item {index}: "tls" must be true or false.
connectedBanner: Connected {address}. The first sync starts within a minute.
errEmail: Email address must not be empty.
errHost: IMAP host must not be empty.
errPort: Port must be a positive whole number.
disableDescription: Reconciliation will stop for this mailbox — no new emails will be ingested from it until re-enabled.
googleNotSetUp: Connecting Gmail by signing in isn't set up yet.
microsoftNotSetUp: Connecting Microsoft 365 by signing in isn't set up yet.
googleSetupSteps: It needs a Google app once: create an OAuth client in Google Cloud Console, add the redirect address shown in Settings, and paste its client ID and secret into Settings › Mailbox sign-in. The button then signs in directly.
microsoftSetupSteps: It needs a Microsoft app once: register an app in Microsoft Entra, add the redirect address shown in Settings, and paste its client ID and secret into Settings › Mailbox sign-in. The button then signs in directly.
askAdminToSetUp: Your system administrator can turn it on in Settings. Until then, add the mailbox with an app password (New mailbox).
deleteDescription: The mailbox is deleted from Eumaeus with all its emails, their analysis, decisions and review items. This can't be undone. Nothing in the mailbox itself is touched.
passwordRejectedNotice: The mail server kept rejecting the saved password, so syncing stopped. Saving a new one starts it again.
gmailAppPasswordHelp: Gmail doesn't accept your normal password over IMAP. Turn on 2-Step Verification, then create a 16-character password under Google Account › Security › App passwords and paste it here.
